metadata.description: Composable transformations of Python+NumPy programs: differentiate, vectorize, JIT to GPU/TPU, and more

commits.subject: Lower `lax.exp2_p` and `lax.log2_p` directly to `stablehlo.exp2` and `stablehlo.log2`
Automated Code Change
Use lax.polynomial for Horner evaluations in lgamma, random, and scipy.special.
Skip `test_emit_pipeline_multicore_no_pipelining` on TPU generations < 4.
Disable `ragged_collective_test` under ASan on GPU and ASan/TSan on TPU.
Merge pull request #41331 from ROCm:araganes/rocm-pip-extras
Update XLA dependency to use revision http://github.com/openxla/xla/commit/23d273a75c335d5e7a72f691109bdf8ed964a334
Merge pull request #41717 from mattjj:push-zwymxyrkkwtw
Compute a two-term Maclaurin series in `lax_numpy._i1_maclaurin`
[custom_vjp] pass gradient refs to rules that take accumulators under remat, jit and scan
Apply core grid offsets in Pallas emit_pipeline when no_pipelining=True.
Merge pull request #41073 from mattjj:push-nwmmzykntoov
[state] raise instead of repeating Ref writes in a disable_jit while_loop
[state] carry the predicate in while_loops whose cond uses a ref
Merge pull request #41693 from mattjj:push-oltnumtxtxul
Merge pull request #41701 from mattjj:push-kxpyoqknwxkt
Support Format in jax.dlpack.from_dlpack to override imported layout.
Align Pallas erf_inv lowering with lax.erf_inv in accurate mode.
Add `include_in_jaxpr_eqn_ctx` to configs to make it easier to add configs into jaxpr eqn context
Preserve HLO op_name metadata when full tracebacks are disabled.
